attchmntText: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the exchange about the receipt of Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, under SEBI regulations. CARE Ratings Limited issued the report covering the period from July 24, 2026, to September 30, 2026. The company received gross proceeds of 450 crore in the Public Offer Account, with 400 crore attributable to the fresh issue. Net proceeds available for utilization amounted to 377.16 crore after deducting issue expenses of 22.84 crore. During the quarter, the company utilized 371.60 crore towards the stated objects of the issue. The monitoring agency confirmed that all utilization was as per disclosures in the Offer Document. There were no deviations from the objects of the issue. The means of finance for the disclosed objects have not changed. No major deviations were observed as this is the first report since the IPO. The company is in the industrial minerals sector, with promoters from the Chadda family.

attchmntText: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Company Secretary/Compliance Officer
voiceSummary: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 751.25 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net profit of 2,972.05 lakhs for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 2,220.80 lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 51,945.37 lakhs for the quarter. The board noted the resignation of Ms. Riddhi Harish Varma as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 21, 2026. Ms. Jigyasa Jha was appointed to this role effective November 23, 2026.

attchmntText: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited submitted a revised investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The revision corrects the unit of measurement for coal tonnage from MT to million MT. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue from operations of 1,176.50 crore rupees, up 89.1% year on year. Normalised EBITDA for the half year was 183.57 crore rupees, a 48.7% increase. Cash profit for H1 FY27 stood at 100.83 crore rupees. The closing order book as of September 30, 2026, was 8,633.94 crore rupees. The company maintains FY27 guidance for revenue growth of 45 to 50% year on year and EBITDA growth of 35% or more.

attchmntText: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated)for the quarter ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for H1 FY27 grew 89.13% year on year to 1,176.50 crore rupees. EBITDA increased 48.69% to 183.57 crore rupees. Net profit after tax was 22.25 crore rupees. Cash profit rose 59.30% to 100.83 crore rupees. Net debt to equity ratio improved to 0.95x. The company added 4,045 crore rupees in new orders. The order book stood at 8,633.94 crore rupees as of September 30, 2026. CRISIL upgraded the long-term rating to Crisil A- with a Positive outlook. The company reiterated its FY27 guidance for revenue growth of 45 to 50% year on year.
